note: Afternoon; two alternatives, second a phrase; neither is an unextended time noun.
Autumn; same form as winter in the source, initial stress.
Day; two alternatives, day noun dis and sun word suri; must be split.
Day after tomorrow; phrase, unmarked.
Downhill; unmarked.
East; unmarked Purik loan.
Evening; two alternatives with different stress positions.
Month; explicitly no data. Calendar-name column says Tibetan without giving individual forms; do not manufacture entries.
Morning; initial stress.
Night; long aa, unmarked.
Sunny slope; a two-word expression, palatalized n in first member. Stored min is not the printed grease miŋ; the supposed homonym is an extraction error.
Shady slope; only grib, unmarked. Stored mys was displaced from previous sunny-slope row. Purik loan.
Seasonal migration; two-word expression with two stresses, not one lexical accent.
Spring; two alternatives, with the same pair used in reverse order for summer. Stored welo is not secure source vocalism; exact barred/central u normalized as u.
Summer; two alternatives, same pair as spring. Initial uulo stress and final bazun stress are distinct lexical formations, not an e/u seasonal accent alternation.
Today; unmarked.
Uphill; unmarked, barred/central u normalized as u, not stored e.
West; palatalized n and underlined final b, unmarked Purik loan.
Winter; initial stress, same form as autumn.
Year; two alternatives, first final-stressed. Source discussion has jokyr; table appears lokyr, so initial consonant discrepancy remains explicitly source-internal.
Earth; unmarked doubled central vowel; quality normalized approximately.
Earthquake; final stress, Purik loan.
Forest; two alternatives, second a regionally borrowed jungle word with final stress.

Highest summer pasture; all three expressions occur before the hill row. DB caris/naglis assigned hill may be row-boundary errors; preserve this page layout and flag semantic attachment for checking. First expression includes the summer uulo member.
Hill; unmarked, final velar nasal, not stored zuy.
Mountain; same form as hill, unmarked.
River; unmarked.
Sand; initial stress.
Spring of water; initial stress, source appears urtsuu with long final vowel rather than ortsu. Exact barred/central u quality approximate.
Stone; initial stress.
